ui.android_platform.it_follows_your_medi: It follows your media volume and stays quiet when your phone is on silent or vibrate.
ui.android_platform.it_also_follows_your: It also follows your phone's touch vibration setting.
ui.android_platform.if_daybook_has_earne: If Daybook has earned it, a rating on Google Play helps other puzzlers find it.
ui.archive_screen.pick_a_day_to_play_it: Pick a day to play it.
ui.home_screen.press_and_hold_a_puzzle_t: Press and hold a puzzle to move it.
ui.levels_screen.finish_all_five_boards_: Finish all five boards to open the next.
ui.reminder.the_whole_day_is_ahead_of: The whole day is ahead of you
ui.reminder.your_puzzles_are_ready_when_: {greeting} {time}: your puzzles are ready when you are.
ui.reminder.one_quiet_note_at_and_none: One quiet note at {hourLabel_hour_}, and none on a day you've already played. You can change the time or turn it off in Settings.
ui.welcome.today_s_three_over_the_grid: Today's three, over the grid, are a quick one, a longer one and a word or number one: gentle ones while you find your feet, then the same three as everyone else. Tap the ? on any puzzle for its rules and a one-minute walkthrough.
ui.welcome.at_the_top_daily_for_today: At the top: Daily for today's board (tap it again for Random, a fresh one any time), Levels for sets of five, and Training to practise each puzzle's techniques. Daily and Random come in Standard, Hard and Expert.
ui.welcome.the_buttons_by_the_title_open: The buttons by the title open the archive of every past day and your achievements. The chart badge with your streak opens your stats.
ui.welcome.press_and_hold_a_puzzle_to: Press and hold a puzzle to move it. Until you do, the ones you play most come first, and the easiest to pick up lead among the rest.
ui.finish_praise.you_re_back_and_your_st: You're back, and your streak is still going.
ui.finish_praise.that_one_fought_back_an: That one fought back, and you stuck with it.
ui.finish_praise.faster_than_of_your_own: Faster than {pct}% of your own {solve_difficulty_label} solves.
ui.finish_praise.hints_are_how_a_move_st: Hints are how a move sticks. Look for that one next time.
ui.finish_praise.standard_hard_and_exper: Standard, Hard and Expert, all on one day's boards.
ui.finish_praise.this_board_needed_solve: This board needed {it}: solved without help.
ui.play_screen.clear_this_board_and_try_: Clear this board and try it again, or deal a new random one.
ui.play_screen.the_board_resets_and_your: The board resets and your lives come back.
ui.play_screen.the_board_goes_back_to_ho: The board goes back to how it began.
ui.play_screen.h_asks_for_a_hint_esc: H asks for a hint, Esc closes it
ui.share_card.first_guess_nothing_to_imp: First guess. Nothing to improve on.
ui.share_card.every_pick_a_set_nothing_t: Every pick a set. Nothing to improve on.
ui.share_card.a_clean_mate_nothing_to_im: A clean mate. Nothing to improve on.
ui.share_card.on_par_nothing_taken_back_: On par, nothing taken back. Nothing to improve on.
ui.share_card.a_clean_solve_nothing_to_i: A clean solve. Nothing to improve on.
ui.share_card.all_three_done_a_tidy_day: All three done. A tidy day's work.
ui.share_card.a_fine_start_on_today_s: A fine start on today's three.
ui.rate_row.daybook_is_open_source_if_it: Daybook is open source. If it has earned it, a star on GitHub helps other puzzlers find it.
ui.settings_screen.message: English and Russian word puzzles are listed as separate games. The language setting changes interface text and guidance.
ui.settings_screen.a_running_clock_above: A running clock above the board. Off or on, your time is counted, shown when you solve, and kept for your statistics.
ui.settings_screen.soft_sounds_as_you_pl: Soft sounds as you play, and a short tune when you solve a puzzle. {SOLVE_SOUND_NOTE}
ui.settings_screen.a_light_tap_when_a_mo: A light tap when a move lands, a firmer one when a bump costs a life, and a short buzz when you solve. {VIBRATION_NOTE}
ui.settings_screen.daybook_isn_t_allowed: Daybook isn't allowed to send notifications. Allow them in your phone's settings, then try again.
ui.settings_screen.one_quiet_note_a_day_: One quiet note a day at a time you choose, and none on a day you've already solved a daily.
ui.settings_screen.always_on_press_and_h: Always on: press and hold does whatever a double tap does, the numbers and letters on a board stay inside their squares at large font sizes, and what is right or wrong is never shown by colour alone.
ui.settings_screen.stills_the_confetti_s: Stills the confetti, sparkles, shakes and slides, and holds the hint glow steady. System follows your device's setting.
ui.settings_screen.light_or_dark_or_the_: Light or dark, or the same as your device.
ui.settings_screen.lexicon_s_words_come_: Lexicon's words come from SCOWL (Spell Checker Oriented Word Lists), Copyright 2000-2016 by Kevin Atkinson, used under its permissive licence. The lists are provided "as is" without warranty, and Kevin Atkinson makes no representations about their suitability for any purpose.
ui.settings_screen.fredoka_copyright_201: Fredoka, Copyright 2016 The Fredoka Project Authors, used under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
ui.settings_screen.your_own_order_puzzle: Your own order. Puzzles added later join at the end.
ui.settings_screen.most_played_first_ove: Most played first, over the last two months. Press and hold a puzzle on the home screen to move it.
ui.settings_screen.practise_the_hints_te: Practise the hints' techniques one at a time, on real boards.
ui.streak_calendar.play_on_5_of_any_7: Play on 5 of any 7 days to keep your streak going.
ui.techniques_screen.techniques_you_ve_b: Techniques you've been shown in hints
ui.this_week.a_fresh_week_today_s_boards: A fresh week: today's boards are ready.
ui.training_screen.pick_a_puzzle_then_a_: Pick a puzzle, then a technique, and practise it on real boards. Get {Training_RUN} right in a row to pass it.
ui.training_screen.each_technique_the_hi: Each technique the hints use, with real boards to practise on. Get {Training_RUN} right in a row to pass it. Hints are always there to help, and using one never breaks your run.
ui.training_screen.a_whole_board_that_ne: A whole {value1} board that needs every technique above.
ui.training_screen.opens_when_every_tech: Opens when every technique above is passed.
ui.training_screen.that_s_it_your_run_is: That's it. {made_explanation} Your run is kept for the next one you solve on your own.
ui.training_screen.final_board_unlocked_: Final board unlocked. Solve it to become a {name} graduate.
ui.training_screen.the_final_board_is_op: {progress}. The final board is open: solve it to become a {name} graduate.
ui.training_screen.solved_with_a_show_me: Solved, with a Show me along the way. Start again to solve it on your own.
ui.training_screen.this_board_needs_ever: This board needs every technique you've practised. Hints are here if you're stuck; solve it without a Show me to pass.
ui.web_platform.this_browser_has_the_bac: This browser has {solves_p_solvesHere_}; the backup has {solves_p_solvesInBackup_}. Importing replaces everything here with the backup.
ui.web_platform.progress_lives_in_this_b: Progress lives in this browser only. Keep a copy, or move it to another device.
ui.web_platform.the_same_daily_puzzles_i: The same daily puzzles, installed. It asks for no permissions at all, not even the internet, so there is no tracking and nothing to sign up for. No ads, free, works offline.
ui.web_platform.add_daybook_to_your_home: Add Daybook to your Home Screen
ui.web_platform.tap_share_then_add_to_ho: Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. It opens full screen like an app and works offline, and your progress is safer: Safari can clear a website's data after a week unused, but not a Home Screen app's.
ui.web_platform.a_browser_cannot_see_you: A browser cannot see your phone's silent switch, so turn this off if you want it quiet.
ui.web_platform.only_where_the_browser_c: Only where the browser can vibrate: Chrome on Android can, iPhone and iPad cannot.
ui.web_storage.that_file_is_not_a_dayboo: That file is not a Daybook backup.
ui.web_storage.that_backup_did_not_fit_i: That backup did not fit in this browser's storage. Nothing changed.
